protocol.device_boundary: t_device_op_graph_us: captured external event nodes around each logical op on one non-default stream; arithmetic mean of bounded graph repetitions; separate from eager API
protocol.api_boundary: separate synchronized host wall-clock passes; native reused outputs, torch allocated outputs
protocol.host_feed_boundary: host enqueue wall clock including Python/ctypes descriptors and native dispatch; excludes final synchronization; not pure ctypes cost
protocol.search_boundary: first synchronized invocation per baseline, includes initialization and applicable search; outside steady state
protocol.graph: required for device-only timing; capture and warm replay excluded; no silent eager fallback
protocol.workspace_limit: framework managed; no explicit byte cap
protocol.baseline_cache_isolation: tuned baseline runs in a fresh dedicated process; synchronized batches dispatched in seeded randomized order
protocol.correctness: full FP32 same-policy comparison and 64 independently computed FP64 output points per shape/implementation before timing

statistics.point: median(batch medians baseline) / median(batch medians candidate)
statistics.bootstrap: paired batch resampling; within this run only, not cross-run stability

limitations: Receipt consistency is not an independent proof of execution or process isolation.
Run-level UUID is consistent; identity-free shape shards cannot independently exclude mixed GPU/source data. Download manifest and execution receipts must supplement this check.
FP64 receipts are checked for distinct valid points and numerical inequalities; expected values are not recomputed from inputs here.
